text: And these so-called old leaders are still in possession of great strong suits and well developed infrastructure, technological advantages, scientific advantages, scientific schools, and so on and so forth. That said, this isn't the nature of things. This is in the nature of humanity and in the nature of economy that changes cannot be stopped. The world is always changing, and this is attested to by the objective facts over the last five years. And I think these statistics have already been cited by our colleague from Indonesia.
